name: Apogee Acquisition Corp
summary: Apogee Acquisition Corp. functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) established with the express goal of completing a business combination. Its mandate involves pursuing a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization, or another analogous transaction with one or more businesses. The company itself was constituted on November 11, 2025, and its principal place of business is located in Cheyenne, Wyoming.
